c1-7-001.gate_key: adv_can | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: The next bus is in an hour, so we ___ walk. | might as well

item.q: Choose the correct option: The next bus is in an hour, so we ___ walk.
item.why: *might / may as well* + base verb = it is the only sensible thing to do: *we might as well walk*.
item.why_lv: *might / may as well* + pamatforma = tas ir vienīgais saprātīgais: *we might as well walk*.

c1-7-002.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Write one word in each gap: Rarely ___ I ___ such a beautiful sunset. (have / see) |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: Rarely ___ I ___ such a beautiful sunset. (have / see)
item.why: After *Rarely* at the start, the helping verb comes before the subject: *Rarely have I seen…*
item.why_lv: Pēc *Rarely* teikuma sākumā palīgdarbības vārds stāv pirms teikuma priekšmeta: *Rarely have I seen*…

c1-7-003.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | Never I have felt so tired in my life.

key.correct: Never I have felt so tired in my life.
wrong: Hardly had we sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had she arrived than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances should you open this door.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: After *Never* at the start: helping verb + subject: *Never have I felt so tired.*
item.why_lv: Pēc *Never* teikuma sākumā: palīgdarbības vārds + teikuma priekšmets: *Never have I felt so tired.*
item.correct: Never I have felt so tired in my life.
wrong: Hardly had we sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had she arrived than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances should you open this door.

c1-7-004.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Write one word in each gap: Not until the guests had gone ___ we ___ the stain on the carpet. (notice) |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: Not until the guests had gone ___ we ___ the stain on the carpet. (notice)
item.why: *Not until* + first clause, then inversion in the second (with *did* for the past simple): *did we notice*.
item.why_lv: *Not until* + pirmā daļa, tad *inversija* otrajā (Past Simple ar *did*): *did we notice*.

c1-7-005.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | So loud ___ the music that we couldn't hear each other. |

item.q: So loud ___ the music that we couldn't hear each other.
item.why: *So* + adjective at the start, then *be* before the subject: *So loud was the music that…*
item.why_lv: *So* + īpašības vārds sākumā, tad *be* pirms teikuma priekšmeta: *So loud was the music that*…

c1-7-006.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | text | Start with *Had*: If I had known about the traffic, I would have left earlier. |

accepted: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
Had I known about the traffic, I'd have left earlier.

item.q: Start with *Had*: If I had known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
item.why: A condition without *if*: *Had* + subject + past participle: *Had I known…*
item.why_lv: Nosacījums bez *if*: *Had* + teikuma priekšmets + 3. forma: *Had I known*…
answers: Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
Had I known about the traffic, I'd have left earlier.

c1-7-007.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | text | Start with *Should*: If you need any help, please call reception. |

accepted: Should you need any help, please call reception.

item.q: Start with *Should*: If you need any help, please call reception.
item.why: A formal condition without *if*: *Should* + subject + base verb: *Should you need any help…*
item.why_lv: Oficiāls nosacījums bez *if*: *Should* + teikuma priekšmets + pamatforma: *Should you need any help*…
answers: Should you need any help, please call reception.

c1-7-008.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Here ___ the bus! Quick, get your bag. (come) |

item.q: Here ___ the bus! Quick, get your bag. (come)
item.why: After *Here* with a noun subject, the verb comes first: *Here comes the bus!* (but *Here it comes!*)
item.why_lv: Pēc *Here*, ja teikuma priekšmets ir lietvārds, darbības vārds stāv pirmais: *Here comes the bus!* (bet *Here it comes*!)

c1-7-009.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | text | Start with *What*: I need a long holiday. |

accepted: What I need is a long holiday.

item.q: Start with *What*: I need a long holiday.
item.why: *What* + subject + verb + *is* puts the focus on the thing: *What I need is a long holiday.*
item.why_lv: *What* + teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds + *is* izceļ *lietu*: *What I need is a long holiday.*
answers: What I need is a long holiday.

c1-7-010.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Cold ___ it was, we went for a swim in the lake. |

item.q: Cold ___ it was, we went for a swim in the lake.
item.why: Adjective + *though / as* + subject + verb = although it was cold: *Cold though it was, …*
item.why_lv: Īpašības vārds + *though / as* + teikuma priekšmets + darbības vārds = lai gan bija *auksti*: *Cold though it was*, …

c1-7-011.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | Walking into the office, the lights were all off.

key.correct: Walking into the office, the lights were all off.
wrong: Opening the door, she saw the cat on the table.
Built in the 1930s, the bridge is still in use.
Not knowing what to say, I kept quiet.

item.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
item.why: A participle clause has the same subject as the main clause. The lights were not walking: *Walking into the office, I saw that the lights were all off.*
item.why_lv: *Divdabja teicienam* ir tas *pats* teikuma priekšmets, kas *galvenajam teikumam*. *Gaismas* negāja: *Walking into the office, I saw that the lights were all off.*
item.correct: Walking into the office, the lights were all off.
wrong: Opening the door, she saw the cat on the table.
Built in the 1930s, the bridge is still in use.
Not knowing what to say, I kept quiet.

c1-7-012.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | ___ finished the report, she went home early. (have) |

item.q: ___ finished the report, she went home early. (have)
item.why: *Having* + past participle: the first action was complete before the second: *Having finished the report, she went home.*
item.why_lv: *Having* + 3. forma: pirmā darbība bija pabeigta pirms otrās: *Having finished the report, she went home.*

c1-7-013.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | Not ___ anyone in the city, he felt very lonely at first. (know) |

item.q: Not ___ anyone in the city, he felt very lonely at first. (know)
item.why: *Not* + *-ing* for a reason: *Not knowing anyone, he felt lonely.* *Not* goes before the participle.
item.why_lv: *Not + -ing iemeslam*: *Not knowing anyone, he felt lonely.* *Not* stāv pirms *divdabja*.

c1-7-014.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | ___ in a cool, dry place, the seeds will keep for years. (store) |

item.q: ___ in a cool, dry place, the seeds will keep for years. (store)
item.why: A past participle at the start for a passive meaning (= if they are stored): *Stored in a cool, dry place, the seeds will keep.*
item.why_lv: 3. forma sākumā ciešamās kārtas nozīmei (= ja tās glabā): *Stored in a cool, dry place, the seeds will keep.*

c1-7-015.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | ___ prices going up every month, many families are struggling. |

item.q: ___ prices going up every month, many families are struggling.
item.why: *With* + noun + *-ing* describes the situation: *With prices going up every month, …*
item.why_lv: *With* + lietvārds + *-ing* apraksta situāciju: *With prices going up every month*, …

c1-7-016.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: ___ no questions, the chair closed the meeting. | There being

item.q: Choose the correct option: ___ no questions, the chair closed the meeting.
item.why: *There being* + noun gives the reason in formal style: *There being no questions, the chair closed the meeting.*
item.why_lv: *There being* + lietvārds oficiālā stilā norāda *iemeslu*: *There being* no *questions, the chair closed the meeting*.

c1-7-017.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | The river burst its banks, ___ the streets near the station. (flood) |

item.q: The river burst its banks, ___ the streets near the station. (flood)
item.why: An *-ing* clause after the main clause for its direct result: *…, flooding the streets.*
item.why_lv: *-ing teiciens* aiz galvenā teikuma tiešam rezultātam: …, *flooding the streets*.

c1-7-018.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: ___ hearing the news, she burst into tears. | On

item.q: Choose the correct option: ___ hearing the news, she burst into tears.
item.why: *On* + *-ing* = at the moment when: *On hearing the news* = when she heard the news.
item.why_lv: *On + -ing* = tajā brīdī, kad: *On hearing the news* = kad viņa dzirdēja ziņu.

c1-7-019.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | Keep the jar in the fridge once ___. (open) |

item.q: Keep the jar in the fridge once ___. (open)
item.why: *once* + past participle (= once it has been opened): *Keep refrigerated once opened.*
item.why_lv: *once* + 3. forma (= kad tas ir atvērts): *Keep refrigerated once opened.*

c1-7-020.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | ___ by the queue outside, the new café is very popular. (judge) |

item.q: ___ by the queue outside, the new café is very popular. (judge)
item.why: A fixed comment phrase: *Judging by…* (it does not need the subject of the main clause).
item.why_lv: Nemainīgs komentāra *izteiciens*: *Judging by*… (tam nav vajadzīgs galvenā teikuma priekšmets).
